# Browser Test Records

This folder keeps two historical records captured from real keyboard-driven play. They let individual scenarios run on their own after the test output has been cleaned:

- `earned-progress.json`: the five-kitchen, three-star clear record from before 2026-10-12. It contains only star ratings, scores, volume and mute settings, with no cookies or account credentials.
- `single-page-results-real.json`: the ingredient-waste record of 11 ingredient types from a real five-minute round played on 2026-10-12. The standalone results-layout test uses it.

These records are not clear results earned by the current version, and they are never imported into a player's everyday save. The star boundaries that the layout test constructs separately are UI fixtures only and do not represent actual clears.

The tests read same-named records generated by the current run in `artifacts/` first. If there are none, they fall back to the historical records here. A full test run still produces fresh records through normal play.

Run `npm run clean:test` to delete screenshots, reports and temporary output while keeping this folder and the test sources.
